questions.question: 🦅 Sami examines a cavity and says: 'Direct composite, it's fast and aesthetic!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And adhesion?' What is adhesion in conservative dentistry?
options: The mechanical and chemical bond between the composite and the tooth structure
The bonding of the crown to the tooth
The fixation of the removable prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Adhesion is the key to successful composite restorations.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you know composites well!'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a deep cavity, says: 'We need to protect the pulp.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'We put composite directly!' Why is protecting the pulp important?
options: To avoid pulpal irritation and necrosis of the tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pulpal protection is essential to preserve tooth vitality.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will put a liner before the composite.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity on a baby tooth, says: 'We put amalgam, it's strong!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And composite?' Which material is preferable for a baby tooth?
options: Composite is preferable for aesthetics and adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Composite offers better aesthetics and superior adhesion for baby teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use composite for children.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, preparing a cavity, says: 'We must respect Black's principles.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Black is outdated!' What are Black's principles?
options: Rules for cavity preparation (forms, extensions, retentions)
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Black's principles are the basics of cavity preparation.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are a purist!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing an interproximal cavity, says: 'We make an access cavity through the occlusal surface.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And tooth structure preservation?' Why preserve tooth structure?
options: To maintain tooth resistance and avoid fractures
To make more room for composite
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Structure preservation is fundamental in conservative dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make a more conservative cavity.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, choosing a composite, says: 'We must choose the right shade.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Shade is not important!' How to choose a composite shade?
options: With a shade guide under natural or neutral lighting
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Shade choice is crucial for aesthetics.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are an expert in aesthetics!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity under a crown, says: 'We need to remake the crown.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'What if we repaired it?' When can a crown be repaired?
options: If the cavity is small and accessible, a repair may be considered
Never, the crown must always be remade
Only if the crown is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cavities under crowns can sometimes be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate if a repair is possible.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, polymerizing a composite, says: 'We must respect the polymerization time.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'We can speed it up with a more powerful lamp!' Why respect polymerization time?
options: To ensure complete polymerization and good composite performance
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Incomplete polymerization can lead to leakage and sensitivity.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you have become very technical!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing recurrent caries, says: 'It's the composite's fault!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'It might be poor adhesion.' What is recurrent caries?
options: A cavity that appears around or under an existing restoration
A new cavity on a healthy tooth
A cavity that recurs after treatment
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Recurrent caries are often due to adhesion defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the sealing of my restorations.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, finishing a restoration, says: 'We must polish the composite.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Polishing is optional!' Why polish a composite?
options: To improve aesthetics, reduce plaque, and prolong lifespan
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Polishing is essential for the longevity of the restoration.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are a true perfectionist!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a deep cavity, says: 'We'll do an inlay.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And direct composite?' What is an inlay?
options: An indirect laboratory restoration, cemented into the tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Inlays are indicated for large cavities requiring increased resistance.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make an inlay for this patient.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a cusp fracture, says: 'We need an onlay.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'No, a crown!' What is an onlay?
options: An indirect restoration that covers one or more cusps
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The onlay is more conservative than a crown.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a root cavity, says: 'It's difficult to treat.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'We need an appropriate material.' Which material is recommended for root caries?
options: A glass ionomer or a flowable composite with good adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Adhesive materials are preferable for root caries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use a glass ionomer.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, preparing a cavity, says: 'We need a bevel on the enamel.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'The bevel is useless!' Why make a bevel?
options: To improve adhesion and the aesthetic composite/enamel transition
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The bevel improves aesthetics and sealing.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are a real pro!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity under a veneer, says: 'We need to remake the veneer.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'What if we repaired it?' When can a veneer be repaired?
options: If the cavity is small and does not affect aesthetics, a repair is possible
Never, the veneer must be remade
Only if the veneer is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cavities under veneers can sometimes be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the possibility of repair.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, choosing an adhesive system, says: 'We need a total-etch system.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Self-etch is faster!' What is the difference?
options: Total-etch etches enamel and dentin, self-etch is more selective
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The choice depends on the clinical situation.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you know adhesive systems well!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity on a root-treated tooth, says: 'We'll put a post and core.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And composite?' What is a post and core?
options: A core build-up to anchor a crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The post and core is indicated to rebuild a root-treated tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make a post and core for this tooth.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing a crack on a tooth, says: 'We need to monitor.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'We need to restore immediately!' When should a crack be restored?
options: If the crack is symptomatic or deep, a restoration is indicated
Only if the crack is visible
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Symptomatic cracks require intervention.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are cautious!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity on a wisdom tooth, says: 'We extract!' 🐆 Mina replies: 'What if we restored it?' When can a wisdom tooth be restored?
options: If the tooth is well positioned and functional, it can be restored
Only if the tooth is healthy
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Functional wisdom teeth can be preserved.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the possibility of restoration.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, preparing a cavity, says: 'We need to protect the dentin.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'Composite is enough!' Why is protecting dentin important?
options: To avoid post-operative sensitivity and protect the pulp
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Dentin protection is essential for patient comfort.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really attentive!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity on an anterior tooth, says: 'We'll put composite.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'And layering?' What is layering?
options: The application of successive layers of composite of different shades for aesthetics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Layering allows optimal aesthetic rendering.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will layer for this tooth.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, seeing an extensive cavity, says: 'We need a ceramic inlay.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'A composite inlay is cheaper!' What are the advantages of a ceramic inlay?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Ceramic offers excellent longevity and aesthetics.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are an expert in materials!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing a cavity on a primary tooth, says: 'We extract.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'What if we restored it?' When can a primary tooth be restored?
options: If the tooth is conservable and important for space, we restore it
Only if the tooth is decayed
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Conservable primary teeth should be restored.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will restore this baby tooth.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, choosing a composite, says: 'We need a nanohybrid composite.' 🦅 Sami replies: 'A microhybrid is enough!' What is the difference?
options: Nanohybrids offer better polishability and resistance
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Nanohybrids are more performant for anterior restorations.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are a true connoisseur!'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami, seeing recurrent caries, says: 'We need to redo the entire restoration.' 🐆 Mina replies: 'What if we repaired it?' When can a restoration be repaired?
options: If the cavity is small and does not affect the structure, a repair is possible
Only if the restoration is composite
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Repairs are possible for small recurrent caries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will repair this restoration.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami and 🐆 Mina discuss the future of conservative dentistry. Sami says: '3D printers will replace composites!' Mina replies: 'They will complement, but not replace.' What is the future of conservative dentistry?
options: Technology complements conservative dentistry, but does not replace it
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Technology is a complementary tool to conservative dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree, we keep our know-how!'
